stories.title: Shot of the Day
stories.detail: Albatross on the 3rd - a shot in a million

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: The club extends a warm welcome to Jaden Newbigging from Wagga City GC. Play well and enjoy the Bidgee.

stories.title: A Very Thorough Hole
stories.detail: +6 on hole 2 - a comprehensive, detailed, expensive visit to that part of the course

stories.title: What On Earth Happened
stories.detail: +4 on hole 4 - the scorecard needs a moment to recover from that

stories.title: Four and Forgotten
stories.detail: Quadruple bogey on hole 4 - the committee has been informed and they are also confused

stories.title: Triple Trouble
stories.detail: Triple bogey on hole 5 - that one is going to take some forgetting

stories.title: Looking for the Course
stories.detail: Nothing from the first 5 on holes 1-5

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: Peter Clucas slipping to 37th - held 9th longer than Melbourne held eighth

stories.title: Wooden Spoon Watch
stories.detail: Peter Hastie on spoon watch - the rebuild starts on the very next tee
